prompt: Create a minimalist botanical silhouette illustration on a vertical 2:3 canvas. Use a deep nearly black teal background with a tall rounded-arch window shape centered in the composition, glowing warm golden yellow like sunset light. In front of the arch, place exactly 3 main lotus-plant silhouettes in pure black: 1 large wavy-edged lotus leaf entering from the upper left with a long thin curved stem sweeping downward across the arch, 1 large wavy lotus leaf near the bottom center-left with its stem dropping out of frame, and 1 closed lotus bud on the right side attached to a tall curved stem that crosses another stem near the lower right. Add exactly 1 small dragonfly perched delicately on the tip of the lotus bud, shown in black with faint translucent golden wings and fine line details. Keep the composition elegant, flat, high-contrast, and graphic, with smooth vector-like shapes, no text, no border, no watermark, and generous negative space.
